revisions.original_candidate: Dette %1$s-billede er for komplekst til at afgøre, om det indeholder flere enkeltbilleder. AN Paint åbner kun et stillbillede og bevarer ingen animation.
revisions.final_value: Dette %1$s-billede er så komplekst, at det ikke kan afgøres, om det indeholder flere enkeltbilleder. AN Paint åbner kun et stillbillede og bevarer ingen animation.
revisions.rationale: Revise the dangling active infinitive er for komplekst til at afgøre: the image cannot itself decide. New passive clause explicitly retains inability to determine multiplicity due to complexity. Keeps uncertainty, %1$s, still-only opening and loss of all animation; does not turn unknown into confirmed single-frame.

revisions.original_candidate: %1$s En separat gendannelseskopi er bevaret. Brug »Filer > Eksportér gendannelseskopi…« til at gemme dens ZIP-fil. Pak canvas.png ud fra den, og indlæs billedet for at bruge de normale skaleringsindstillinger, hvis det er nødvendigt.
revisions.final_value: %1$s En separat gendannelseskopi er bevaret. Brug »Filer > Eksportér gendannelseskopi…« til at gemme dens ZIP-fil. Pak canvas.png ud af ZIP-filen, og indlæs billedet for at bruge de normale skaleringsindstillinger, hvis det er nødvendigt.
revisions.rationale: All clauses preserve already-rendered reason prefix, actual separate-copy preservation, actionable export menu, literal canvas.png and optional normal resizing. Revise ud fra den to ud af ZIP-filen: extraction is from inside an archive, not based on it; explicit archive referent also removes den ambiguity. Filer and same-group Eksportér gendannelseskopi… retained.

revisions.final_value: Pixeldata fra den automatiske lagring mangler.
revisions.rationale: Revise til automatisk lagring to fra den automatiske lagring: consumer is reading an existing ZIP and lacks its canvas.png or floating.png entry, not asking for input pixels for a future save. Matches adjacent decoding-error wording and keeps missing distinct from unreadable.

revisions.original_candidate: Gendannelseskopi eksporteret. Pak canvas.png ud fra ZIP-filen, og åbn billedet via »Filer > Load image…«. ZIP-filen indeholder også kladdens indstillinger og en eventuel flydende markering.
revisions.final_value: Gendannelseskopi eksporteret. Pak canvas.png ud af ZIP-filen, og åbn billedet via »Filer > Load image…«. ZIP-filen indeholder også kladdens indstillinger og en eventuel flydende markering.
revisions.rationale: Export success, canvas.png extraction, actual Filer > Load image… command and ZIP contents all retained. Revise ud fra ZIP-filen to idiomatic ud af ZIP-filen. Singular eventuel flydende markering fits one optional floating selection; no settings/selection automatically restored claim.

revisions.original_candidate: Disse billedkrediteringer ville gøre tegningen for stor til at kunne gendannes. Din forrige tegning og krediteringerne er bevaret.
revisions.final_value: Disse billedkrediteringer ville gøre tegningen for stor til at kunne gendannes. Din forrige tegning og de tidligere krediteringer er bevaret.
revisions.rationale: First clause correctly uses hypothetical ville and restore-size limitation, not image dimensions. Revise krediteringerne in second clause to de tidligere krediteringer: definite pronoun otherwise can refer back to the attempted credits in Disse billedkrediteringer and wrongly imply those new edits were retained. Final wording explicitly protects previous drawing and previous credits.

revisions.original_candidate: Billedet blev gemt, men Android kunne ikke åbne deling: %1$s
revisions.final_value: Billedet blev gemt, men Android kunne ikke åbne delingsmenuen: %1$s
revisions.rationale: Revise calqued åbne deling to idiomatic åbne delingsmenuen, the actual Android chooser launch. Prior image write remains successful, subsequent launch failed, and colon plus %1$s retains exception detail. Does not assert share delivery or changed drawing Save destination.

revisions.original_candidate: Bildet ble lagret, men Android kunne ikke åpne deling: %1$s
revisions.final_value: Bildet ble lagret, men Android kunne ikke åpne delingsdialogen: %1$s
revisions.rationale: Revise the calqued åpne deling to idiomatic åpne delingsdialogen. The pinned consumer calls startActivity(Intent.createChooser(...)); naming that dialog accurately expresses the failed sharing-launch outcome without implying attempted recipient delivery. Successful image writing, Android failure and the original %1$s exception detail all remain.

analysis: Seven revisions preserve current consumer semantics: uncertainty remains unconfirmed animation; ZIP extraction names the actual file; missing pixel data refers to stored canvas data; prior credit snapshots remain protected; Intent.createChooser supports the sharing dialog/menu wording. Full values and unchanged numbered parameters bound above. No new acceptance beyond independent receipts.
